lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A highly regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately 10 visible vertical columns and 6-8 horizontal rows across the mid-to-posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical and horizontal bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect at the centroids of the high-luminance blobs, creating a lattice-like geometric pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal feature in the upper third of the flank exhibiting a sharp luminance transition (high intensity on the dorsal edge, low intensity/shadow on the ventral edge) consistent with a lateral ridge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 5-7 high-luminance blobs against a dark background, showing lower spatial density than the primary flank.

other_distinctive_markers: A smaller marine organism, likely a remora, is visible in the lower right quadrant swimming parallel to the shark's ventral-lateral surface.
